note: Display-only company context for the stock page. Live probes ran without any key; keyed responses (Massive, Finnhub, Schwab) are documented examples until the operator's laptop records real ones.

fields: chief executive (P169 without end time P582)

aapl.ceo: an entity without an English label (Q106028933, from 2026-09-01): unlabelled values are dropped

wikidata.decision: fallback only: SEC filings and Massive come first; a chief executive is taken from the issuer's own Form 4 officer titles before Wikidata
wikidata.policy: keyless; a descriptive User-Agent is sent (Wikimedia User-Agent policy)

wikipedia_summary.use: description fallback when Massive is not configured, linked to the article (CC BY-SA)

massive_ticker_details.plans: included in all Stocks plans including Basic ($0); updated daily (massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-overview, read 2026-10-29)
massive_ticker_details.branding: icon_url is a PNG on api.massive.com and needs the key: the desk fetches it server-side, accepts PNG/JPEG only (never SVG) and serves it from its own origin

massive_news.plans: included in all Stocks plans including Basic; updated hourly; Basic has 2 years (massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/news, read 2026-10-29)

finnhub.auth: token query parameter or X-Finnhub-Token header (swagger.json Authentication); the desk sends the header
finnhub.limits: 429 when a plan limit is exceeded; an extra 30 calls/second ceiling (swagger.json Rate Limits)

endpoints./calendar/earnings: freeTier: 1 month of historical earnings and new updates; {earningsCalendar:[{date,hour,year,quarter,epsEstimate,epsActual,revenueEstimate,revenueActual,symbol}]}

finnhub.estimates: EPS and revenue in /calendar/earnings are non-GAAP (swagger description); the page labels them as analyst estimates, separate from SEC-reported EPS

schwab_quote_sections.status: field names in the fundamental/reference/extended/regular sections are not confirmed by a recorded response; each is parsed only if present and the page lists the sections that arrived
schwab_quote_sections.fallback: HTTP 400 for the extra sections -> the plain quote request
